mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If 20-day returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If returns don't correlate with UNRATE increases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth without inflation suggests positive real economic growth, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If returns don't improve with this GDP-inflation pattern.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts in a recovery signal economic expansion, boosting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If returns don't improve when HOUST grows in recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If returns don't correlate with INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: Declining real consumer spending signals weaker demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If returns don't drop when RSAFS is low.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth accompanied by rising unemployment suggests inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If returns don't correlate with this employment pattern.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate in a tightening cycle may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If returns don't drop when FEDFUNDS rises in tightening.
